a.title: Static box: pressure from wall impulses

modelComponents.integrator: drift → pair collisions → walls → bodies, velocity-Verlet kicks when forces present /1
modelComponents.openBoundaries: reservoir-boundary/1 (kinetic flux, optional velocity profile; A-18)

temperature.definition: kT = KE/N (2D, 2 translational DOF per particle; A-03)

a.geometry: closed square box, side L = 125.331 (model units)

reynolds.note: Not definable: the static box has no mean flow and no flow length scale.

elastic.dimensionlessPressureDefinition: P · A_box / (N · kT), with kT = KE/N measured
elastic.definition: P = Σ normal wall impulse / (Δt · wall length), all four walls

pressureVsCollisions.note: P/P_ref vs collisions per particle since measurement start; P_ref = elastic pressure, same seed

convergence.note: Single resolution. Timestep / particle-count convergence is a separate study (validation/Convergence).

pressure.note: Classical references for comparison only; none of these entered the simulation.

collisionFrequency.formula: 2 σ n g(σ) sqrt(π kT/m), g(σ) from Henderson EOS

acceptance.description: No run was halted by the numerical-safety monitor
Energy ledger closes (elastic: KE conserved; inelastic: KE + dissipated = E0)
Gas momentum change equals impulse received from walls
Contacts are resolved within the step they occur in, with small overlap
acceptance.criterion: late-contact fraction < 1e-3 and max overlap < 25 % of contact distance

acceptance.description: Wall pressure measured with adequate statistical precision
The reported pressure uncertainty is statistically valid
acceptance.criterion: ensemble of ≥ 3 independent seeds, or block-averaging plateau in every run
acceptance.measured: ensemble of 5 seeds; plateau in 5/5 runs

acceptance.description: All four walls measure the same pressure
acceptance.criterion: χ² consistency p > 0.001 in every run

acceptance.description: Pressure in the first and second half of the measurement agree
Different seeds give statistically consistent pressures
No sustained near-zero-occupancy region in the elastic gas
acceptance.criterion: no POTENTIAL MODEL / NUMERICAL FAILURE flag
